items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was in that band with Sharpie, huh? When you recorded? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I played tenor...

ctx.x: You know, it was a good band. I like tenor. I cut my teeth on alto, but I could never really control an alto. I never felt like I had an alto saxophone under control. It was an instrument of the devil, you know. But tenor, I got along very well with tenor. And I had enough musical background. In fact, at that time when tenor began, the tenor bands became very popular, I had no problem reading the alto parts, which is a transposition. As a matter of fact, I thank God I never had any trouble with any transposition.…
Who was in that band with Sharpie, huh? When you recorded? Do you remember any of those?

Yes, I played tenor, I think Meyer Weinberg, Gene Meyer was his professional name, played clarinet, Augie Chalang was on drums, and I think Panera was on piano, and I think Cink Martin was on bass. Now I would either have to be Cink Martin or Louis Macenta because Schalke used them almost interchangeably
